licenseNote: Using LGPL builds as conservative default. See R48 (ffmpeg-licensing) for final GPL vs LGPL decision.
upgradePlaybook: 1. Download new FFmpeg binaries for all platforms from the source URLs (or update URLs for new version).
3. Run: npx tsx scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.ts --compute-checksums to generate SHA-256 hashes.
4. Update this file: bump 'version', replace all sha256 values with computed hashes.
5. Run: npx tsx scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.ts --verify to confirm checksums match.
6. Run smoke test: npm test -- --grep ffmpeg-binary to verify binary responds to -version.
7. Test video/audio processing features (probe, thumbnail, transcode, render).
8. If build flags changed (GPL vs LGPL), update licenseNote and sourceUrls.
9. Commit all changes including updated checksums and binaries.
